hypotheses.justification: Recover this instance from the retained [P.flip.IsReduced]. Module.IsReflexive.of_isPerfPair applied to P.toLinearMap and P.flip.toLinearMap gives reflexivity of M and N; Module.IsReflexive.to_isTorsionFree supplies both torsion-freeness instances. RootPairing.instFlipIsReduced applied to P.flip then gives P.flip.flip.IsReduced, which is P.IsReduced by RootPairing.flip_flip. The original proof now applies unchanged. This recovery uses the other reducedness hypothesis and requires no nonempty index type; when ι is empty the theorem is vacuous.

Recover this instance from the retained [P.IsReduced]. Module.IsReflexive.of_isPerfPair applied to P.toLinearMap and P.flip.toLinearMap, followed by Module.IsReflexive.to_isTorsionFree, supplies torsion-freeness of both modules. RootPairing.instFlipIsReduced then supplies P.flip.IsReduced under the remaining finiteness, characteristic-zero and domain assumptions. The original proof applies unchanged. This recovery uses the other reducedness hypothesis and works without nonemptiness assumptions, including empty ι.
